commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Bilal Nadir (Marseille) was quite harsh and Romain Lissorgue didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+3' Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle and it's Hamed Junior Traore (Marseille) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Ethan Nwaneri (Marseille) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
88' It's time for a substitution. Bradley Locko (Brest) comes on in place of Romain Del Castillo.
87' Habib Beye decides to make a substitution. Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg will be replaced by Bilal Nadir (Marseille).
84' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) commits a foul and Romain Lissorgue immediately signals a free kick.
82' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) misses the penalty! He fired the ball towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper pulled off a tremendous diving save to deny him.
82' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
81' Poor challenge! Daouda Guindo (Brest) is penalised for tripping and Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle. PENALTY to Marseille!
80' Ethan Nwaneri (Marseille) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
79' Eric Roy prepares a substitution. Kamory Doumbia is replaced by Lucas Tousart (Brest).
79' Substitution. Himad Abdelli (Marseille) has come on for Quinten Timber.
79' Quinten Timber (Marseille) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
77' Joris Chotard (Brest) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
73' Eric Roy has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest) replacing Junior Dina Ebimbe.
71' Habib Beye has decided to make a change. Ethan Nwaneri (Marseille) replaces Amine Gouiri.
71' Substitution. Igor Paixao walks off the pitch and Hamed Junior Traore (Marseille) comes on as a substitute.
71' Yellow card. Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
70' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
67' Romain Lissorgue shows a yellow card to Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) for his blatant foul.
66' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
65' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) makes a strong challenge and Romain Lissorgue blows for a foul.
63' Igor Paixao (Marseille) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
62' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Amine Gouiri (Marseille), whose header flies narrowly wide of the right post.
61' Timothy Weah (Marseille) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
61' Brest fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
60' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Brest) tricks his way to edge of the area and unleashes a howitzer of a shot towards the inside the right post, but Geronimo Rulli earns his money with a fine reflex save.
59' Quinten Timber (Marseille) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance low towards the middle of the goal, but Gregoire Coudert is alert and makes a decent save.
57' Timothy Weah (Marseille) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
56' A rebound sits up nicely for Emerson (Marseille) and he needs no second invitation to shoot from distance. The effort, however, balloons high over the bar and out for a goal kick.
55' Timothy Weah (Marseille) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
55' Marseille can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
54' A lofted cross from Quinten Timber (Marseille) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
51' One of the players from Marseille times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
49' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
46' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
46' Habib Beye has made a change at the break. Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) has come on in place of Arthur Vermeeren.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Gregoire Coudert intercepts the ball.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) commits a rough challenge and Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle for a foul.
42' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brest comes to nothing.

42' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Brest have a corner.
41' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) wastes a promising chance as he unleashes a first-time shot from mid-range which hits the crossbar!
39' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Marseille.
39' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the right post. Terrific solo effort, though.
38' A cross is whipped in towards Michel Diaz Jr. (Brest) on the edge of the six-yard box. He wins the ball but sends his header just wide of the right post.
37' Timothy Weah (Marseille) brings his opponent down. Romain Lissorgue has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
35' What a big chance! Junior Dina Ebimbe (Brest) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
32' 3:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
32' A long pass, executed by Brendan Chardonnet (Brest), missed the precision to reach his teammates. The ball is behind the touchline and Marseille will take a throw-in.
29' 2 - 0 Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) heads the ball inside the left post after a splendid cross. This timely header produces a wonderful moment.
28' Benjamin Pavard (Marseille) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
27' A cross by Amine Gouiri (Marseille) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
25' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
23' Timothy Weah (Marseille) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
20' The ball is cleared after Mason Greenwood (Marseille) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
15' Good team movement sets up Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post.
14' The corner is swung in but Brest can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
12' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Ludovic Ajorque (Brest).
12' Marseille seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
10' 1 - 0 Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) scores with a header. Despite the ball going into the middle of the goal, the goalkeeper was unable to pull off a save.
8' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) takes a mid-range free kick, but his miskick only goes into the stands. Poor shot!
7' Rough tackle by Daouda Guindo (Brest). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Nayef Aguerd (Marseille) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
5' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
4' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
3' A cross from Hugo Magnetti (Brest) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
1' Marseille are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
1' The match has just started.
Marseille will kick-off.
